titleZh: 纪年画卷 · 闪的后裔与出迦勒底的吾珥
titleEn: Campaign Scroll · Line of Shem & Call from Ur
eraZh: 上古立约 → 列祖时期

events.titleEn: Nations Scattered & The Line of Shem
events.bodyZh: 洪水之后，彩虹之约永立于天；列国从示拿平原分散全地。历史经由闪的谱系，延伸至幼发拉底河下游繁华的迦勒底吾珥——他拉与其子亚伯兰、儿妇撒莱、孙子罗得居住在那里。
events.bodyEn: After the Flood, the Rainbow Covenant stood forever in the clouds, and the nations scattered from Shinar. Through the genealogy of Shem, history reached Ur of the Chaldees along the lower Euphrates, where Terah dwelt with Abram, Sarai, and Lot.

choices.labelZh: 翻开下一卷：自迦勒底吾珥启程
choices.labelEn: Turn the Scroll: Departing Ur of the Chaldees
choices.resultZh: 镜头移向幼发拉底河畔的吾珥古城，家族正整装离开故土。
choices.resultEn: Along the Euphrates at ancient Ur, the household prepares to depart.

events.bodyZh: 荣耀的神早在两河之地向我们显现。父亲他拉带着我们全家与罗得离开迦勒底的吾珥，要往迦南地去。沿幼发拉底河西北而行，前路漫长，我们需要先为同行家眷整备启程物资。
events.bodyEn: The God of glory appeared to us in Mesopotamia. Terah led our household with Sarai and Lot out of Ur of the Chaldees toward Canaan. Before the long march northwest along the Euphrates, how shall we provision our caravan?

choices.labelZh: 多备皮水囊与陶罐，保障旷野饮水（第一章初始活水 +6）
choices.labelEn: Pack extra waterskins & clay jars for the desert road (Ch.1 Water +6)
choices.resultZh: 全队携带充足水源，沿幼发拉底河安稳行至哈兰。
choices.resultEn: Well-supplied with water, the caravan reaches Haran safely.

choices.labelZh: 周全安顿罗得与仆婢家眷同心同行（第一章初始信心 +6%）
choices.labelEn: Unite Lot's household and servants in shared stewardship (Ch.1 Faith +6%)
choices.resultZh: 两家老幼同心启程，队伍秩序井然抵达哈兰。
choices.resultEn: Both households march in harmony and order to Haran.

events.titleZh: 哈兰蒙召 · 万族得福之约
events.titleEn: The Call at Haran · Blessing to All Families
events.bodyZh: 耶和华对亚伯兰说：“你要离开本地、本族、父家，往我所要指示你的地去。我必叫你成为大国，我必赐福给你……地上的万族都要因你得福。”亚伯兰年七十五岁，遵命带着撒莱、罗得与一切人口起行往迦南地去。
events.bodyEn: Yahweh said to Abram: "Get out of your country, and from your relatives, and from your father's house, to the land that I will show you. I will make of you a great nation... and in you all the families of the earth will be blessed." At seventy-five, Abram set out with Sarai and Lot.

choices.labelZh: 凭信顺服，拔营南下渡河进入迦南山地
choices.labelEn: Obey by faith, cross the river, and journey south into Canaan
choices.resultZh: 金色应许之路向西南延展，亚伯兰率队进入迦南。
choices.resultEn: The golden trail extends southwest into the hills of Canaan.

events.titleZh: 示剑摩利橡树与伯特利初筑坛
events.titleEn: Oak of Moreh at Shechem & First Altar at Bethel
events.bodyZh: 我们经过示剑摩利橡树，耶和华显现应许将这地赐给你的后裔。随后迁到伯特利东边的山支搭帐棚——伯特利在西，艾在东——在那里起初筑了一座坛，求告耶和华的名。
events.bodyEn: Passing the oak of Moreh at Shechem, Yahweh promised this land to your offspring. Pitching our tent on the mountain east of Bethel — Bethel on the west and Ai on the east — Abram built an altar there and called on Yahweh's name.

choices.labelZh: 立石初筑祭坛，铭记这起初蒙召之地
choices.labelEn: Raise the unhewn stone altar between Bethel and Ai
choices.resultZh: 起初的坛火燃起于伯特利与艾之间；此后全队继续渐迁南地。
choices.resultEn: The first altar stands between Bethel and Ai before journeying toward the Negev.

events.titleZh: 饥荒下埃及与蒙保守北返伯特利
events.titleEn: Sojourn in Egypt & Return to Bethel
events.bodyZh: 那地遭遇大饥荒，亚伯兰曾下埃及暂居，在危机中仍蒙耶和华保守，带着撒莱、罗得与甚多的金银牲畜从埃及上南地，重返起初在伯特利与艾城之间筑坛的 128×96 高脊营地！
events.bodyEn: Through famine in Egypt, Yahweh preserved Abram and Sarai. Rich in livestock, silver, and gold, Abram went up with Lot out of Egypt through the Negev back to the highland ridge between Bethel and Ai!

choices.labelZh: 进入第一章：归回伯特利七区高地营（创 13）
choices.labelEn: Enter Chapter I: Return to Bethel Highland Camp (Gen 13)
choices.resultZh: 镜头俯冲落入伯特利与艾城之间的七区高脊营地。
choices.resultEn: Descending into the 7-zone highland camp between Bethel and Ai.
